random.name: Pure random
random.about: Every number equally likely. The baseline every model must beat.

hot.name: Hot numbers
hot.about: Favours numbers drawn most often in the last 100 draws.

cold.name: Cold numbers
cold.about: Favours numbers drawn least often in the last 100 draws.

overdue.name: Overdue
overdue.about: Favours numbers that haven't appeared for the longest time.

bayes.name: Bias hunter
bayes.about: Bayesian estimate of each number's true rate, shrunk towards fair. Catches a real machine bias if one exists.

markov.name: Markov chain
markov.about: Learns which numbers tend to follow last draw's numbers.

gbm.name: Machine learning
gbm.about: Gradient-boosted trees on recent frequency, gaps and repeats, retrained every 25 draws.
